classification.difficultyReason: Same cube formula as p11-q10, but the side is the algebraic term 3m, so the student must square a product and multiply by 6.

content.prompt: What would be the formula for the surface area of a cube with side length $3m$?

answer.worked:
The cube has six square faces, each with area $(3m)^2$.
$$\begin{align*}SA&=6\times(3m)^2\\SA&=6\times9m^2\\SA&=54m^2\end{align*}$$
